jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON ELIXIR PARFUM 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
FASHIONABLY LONDON ELIXIR PARFUM 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ.). A more intense and enveloping interpretation that amplifies the relaxed sophistication of London. Bergamot maintains its luminous freshness, while the rose becomes deeper and more velvety. Musk intensifies its clean, polished base, while cedar oil adds warmth and a woody depth, adding presence and character without losing elegance.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody floral | Intense, elegant, and contemporary
